overview_description.description:
Tlon is the corporate vehicle of the open-source Urbit software stack (urbit.org). 

Urbit is a clean-slate reimplementation of the whole system software stack. On the bottom it's a replacement of the lambda calculus, in the middle it's a new functional programming language, on top it's a purely functional network operating system in which address space is property.

Tlon owns approximately half of the entire address-space on the Urbit network.

The goal is to create a new layer over the Internet the way the Internet layered over the PSTN.  This layer can also earn adoption by providing Internet services.  On the Internet, your Urbit ship is a general-purpose personal cloud computer which replaces the 47 special-purpose cloud silos you're currently using.

Tlon's mission is to contribute to the development of Urbit, to provide hosting services for Urbit ships, and to develop other possible business applications on top of the Urbit stack.

product.name: Urbit OS
product.description: A clean-slate operating system and peer-to-peer network designed for individual use, providing a sealed, secure computing environment.

product.name: Urbit ID
product.description: A cryptographic identity and authentication system that serves as a username, network address, and crypto wallet for Urbit OS users.

product.name: Landscape
product.description: A user interface for Urbit OS that supports group communication, chat, and sharing notes and links.

product.name: Azimuth
product.description: A blockchain-based public key infrastructure that manages Urbit address space and identity ownership.

product.name: Urbit Hosting Services
product.description: Services that enable users to quickly join the Urbit network via hosting providers or run Urbit nodes themselves.

product.name: Urbit Grants Program
product.description: A funding program supporting software development, content creation, and community growth within the Urbit ecosystem.
